prompt: What distinguishes Sunday’s problem from the first one?
promptZh: 週日的狀況與前一次有什麼不同？

options.whyZh: 講者說所有機器都比平常慢。

options.text: Clean filters did not prevent a slowdown across the room.
options.zh: 即使濾網乾淨，整間烘衣室還是都比較慢。
options.whyZh: 週日各台都慢，且濾網乾淨，與單台濾網堵住不同。

options.text: Every machine had a blocked lint filter.
options.zh: 每台機器的棉絮濾網都堵住。
options.whyZh: 週日就算濾網乾淨也變慢，並非全數堵塞。

options.text: Only a single machine was available.
options.zh: 只有一台機器可以使用。
options.whyZh: 多台都較慢，沒有只剩一台可用的說法。

explanationZh: 週日各台都慢，且濾網乾淨，與單台濾網堵住不同。
evidence: Last week, dryer three took longer because its lint filter was blocked. On Sunday, every machine took longer, even with clean filters.

vocabulary.note: 此處描述含水氣的室外空氣。
